snippet.title: Lootborne // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4335620/Lootborne

A challenging dark fantasy idle RPG that lives in the corner of your screen. Fight and loot while you work, refine your build, trigger item synergies, and grow stronger. An autobattler with asynchronous PvP, for glory and loot!

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Fate Rate
📚 Publisher: Fate Rate
📅 Release Date: Sep 21, 2026
🎯 Genre: Casual, RPG
